Package kamkeel.npcdbc.api.ability

Interface IDBCAbilityStats

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IDBCStats
    public interface IDBCAbilityStats
extends IDBCStats
    DBC-specific settings for abilities. Extends IDBCStats for universal damage configuration and adds player resource cost/drain and damage scaling fields.
